TITLE: 02 — Nuit d'écluse
SUB: Wet concrete and steel under one sodium lamp. The held gate is the only warm thing in the frame.
RULE: Tap a gate to hold it. Reach the floor.
S_READY: Lamp on, water still, ball waiting above the surface. “Drop the ball”.
S_HELD: The tapped gate glows sodium; a ring drains over 0.9 s.
S_JAM: Ball sits on a moving plate. Attempt +1, “Drop again”.
S_LOAD: “Filling the canal…”: dark water climbs the walls.
